naslov: Boston faces Milwaukee, looks for 5th straight home win
tekst:
Milwaukee Bucks (1-6, 14th in the Eastern Conference) vs. Boston Celtics (5-2, third in the Eastern Conference)
              Boston; Wednesday, 7:30 p.m. EST
              BOTTOM LINE: Boston will try to keep its four-game home win streak alive when the Celtics play Milwaukee.
              Boston went 56-26 overall and 36-16 in Eastern Conference play last season. The Celtics gave up 107.2 points per game while committing 19.0 fouls last season.
              Milwaukee finished 32-50 overall and 21-31 in Eastern Conference games during the 2025-26 season. The Bucks averaged 110.6 points per game last season, 13.9 from the free-throw line and 45.3 from 3-point range.
              INJURIES: Celtics: Paul George: out (rest), Devin Carter: out (illness).
              Bucks: None listed.
